name: core-production-limit
description: Rules audit (core): LRR 68 PRODUCTION - a tactical action's build is capped by the combined PRODUCTION of the player's units in the system (fighters and infantry count one each). The original only printed '### Warning! Exceeding PRODUCTION limit of 4!' (Helper.buildProducedUnitsMessage) and the web refused to commit past it; now the bot's place_ handler, production.produce validate and its payload refuse too (ProductionLimitRule). pbd19@319: ralnel builds at 307 (PRODUCTION 4). A 5-unit payload is refused; then carrier + 2 infantry + 1 infantry (4) is accepted and a 5th unit is refused; the save keeps 4 units produced.
